findings.reason: the node must add `tests/core/test_settings.py` to its scope and retire those four tests, or its stated done-when cannot pass.
findings.text: §21's second node retires the `language` and `vision` seats and its done-when requires `pytest tests/core/test_settings.py …` to exit 0, but that file still carries four tests binding exactly those seats (`test_get_model_language_env_override` :25, `test_get_model_language_default` :89, `test_language_section_returns_model` :172, `test_vision_section_returns_model` :178); once `language`/`vision` leave `MODEL_SECTIONS`, `get_model` raises `Unknown model section` and the node's named gate goes red, yet the section never names these tests in its write paths.

findings.reason: the node cannot be built as written by reusing the async helper, so the plan must name the extension (a shared detection predicate plus a sync sibling) or it will silently duplicate the local-client machinery.
findings.text: §21's third node states the synchronous `call_llm_structured` should take "the same branch as the asynchronous one, through the same local-client helper rather than a second implementation", but the named helper `_get_local_client` (`imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py:87`) returns an `AsyncOpenAI` client and is used only by `_acompletion_local` (:118, dispatched from the async path at :2415); no synchronous local client or synchronous local/`hosted_vllm/` detection exists, so the reuse the plan asserts is not available and the node will fork a second local client beside :87 unless the plan names the owner to extend.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the plan introduces no new module; §14 adds private-config entries plus one scoped run over the existing seeder and claim-bound prefix, and §21 adds configuration seats over the existing accessor (`get_model`/`get_reasoning_effort`), not a family of shallow wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the asynchronous local-completion branch is the owner, and §21's synchronous node asserts a reuse of that owner's client helper which the helper cannot provide.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — supplied counts public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §21 names what it retires in its own text (`language` and `vision` from `MODEL_SECTIONS`, `_MODEL_DEFAULTS`, `_MODEL_ENV_VARS` and `pyproject.toml`, with no compatibility alias), and §14 adds only gitignored private-config entries.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan extends existing machinery correctly for §14 (`seed_facility_roots`/`seed_missing_roots`, `imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426,587`; one shared prefix renderer, `render_path_prefix_clause`, `imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py:268`) and for §21 (`get_model`/`MODEL_SECTIONS`/`register_model_endpoints`, `imas_codex/settings.py:137,237`), but its seat retirement does not cite the existing tests that pin the seats it removes.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — §14 adds no wrapper over the path pipeline (it uses the existing `--root`/`--path-prefix` claim scope, `imas_codex/cli/discover/paths.py:271`), and the new discovery seats are entries in the existing seat tables rather than a parallel model-resolution layer.
